integrity: Universal conclusions are proved directly; exhaustive finite checks are corroboration only. Homotopy is derived from a disk and null-attaching-map decomposition, not experimental homology extrapolation.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted simple cycles with all shortest paths and vertex membership only; not weighted cycles, graph balls, tie-broken paths, or arbitrary graphs. Littlestone dimension is not computed. Comprehensive historical priority has not been established.
title: Parity classification and topology of geodesic shattering on finite cycles
